summary: Cambium Networks' indirect subsidiary CNL, in UK administration since September 14, 2026, sold its defense business and certain fixed broadband product lines to Airspan Communications under a September 22, 2026 Business Sale Agreement, effective immediately with no closing conditions. The base purchase price is US$27.5 million cash, plus a contingent 50% of net accounts-receivable collections capped at US$7.5 million, less costs; Airspan held back US$2.5 million (US$2.0 million pending final statement; US$0.5 million for 18 months). Transitional services and license agreements were signed. Watch contingent recoveries, holdback disputes, and prior Item 5.02 officer departure details.
